legend.budget_exhausted: times the server log shows the reasoning budget forcing the end of the reasoning block
legend.budget_reached: the harness's flag: estimated reasoning at 90 % of the budget or more, or an answer cut at the cap
legend.budget_reopened: times the server log shows the model re-opening its reasoning after such a closure
legend.on-requested: thinking requested on, but the server budget did not engage
legend.reasoning_separated: answers whose reasoning the server returned apart from the visible answer
legend.thinking_leaked: answers whose reasoning appeared in the visible answer (the harness's count)
